entities.name: Theodora Kosara of Bulgaria
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kosara or Cossara was a Bulgarian noblewoman, a daughter or relative of Tsar Samuel of Bulgaria, who was married to Prince Jovan Vladimir of Duklja, the most powerful Serbian principality of the time.
